questions.question: After the Passover, what did the people do to idolatry?
options: Rebuilt all of the altars that their fathers had torn down
Made many treaties with all of the surrounding nations
Broke down the pillars, Asherim, high places, and altars
Ignored the idols entirely and left them all standing
questions.answer: Broke down the pillars, Asherim, high places, and altars

questions.question: What did Hezekiah organize for the support of the priests and Levites?

A standing army to guard the city
